title: Our City, Our Way

question: Is 26.TRUE timed or a Boston Qualifier (BQ)?
answer: No. 26.TRUE is intentionally untimed and is NOT a Boston Qualifier. There are no timing chips, no cutoffs, and no time clocks. Every finisher receives a medal, a ribbon-break moment, and the exact same celebration regardless of whether they complete the distance in 3 hours or 7 hours.

question: What distances are offered?
answer: We offer both a Marathon (26.2 miles) and a Half Marathon (13.1 miles). Both courses run 100% inside Boston city limits through Jamaica Plain, Roxbury, Mattapan, and Dorchester.

question: How does the reverse wave start work?
answer: To ensure that every runner finishes into an energized, packed block party, we start in five reverse waves. Slower paced runners and back-of-the-pack runners start first, while faster paced runners start in subsequent waves. Everyone finishes together!

question: When does registration open and what is the field size?
answer: Registration opens Friday, November 20, 2026 at 8:00 AM EST on RunSignup. The field is capped at 500 total runners: 200 for the full marathon (prioritizing 50 first-time marathoners) and 300 for the half marathon (prioritizing 75 first-timers).

question: Are there training plans available?
answer: Yes! Free community-led marathon and half marathon training plans are developed by certified community run coaches Trish Moran and Lindsey Thorne-Bingham to support runners across all experience levels.

question: How can I volunteer or cheer?
answer: If you're not running, you're cheering! We have 6 dedicated Cheer Zones stationed every 2–3 miles along the course, as well as volunteer roles for bike sweeps, hydration, and finish line crews. Email volunteer@26true.com to join a cheer squad.

question: Is there a race expo or packet pickup?
answer: There is no corporate expo. Bib and swag pickup details will be shared directly with registered runners via email and through community meetups organized by PIONEERS Run Crew.
